checks.label: Every proof uses the same renderer and scene contract.
Every line fits inside its speech bubble.
Feet or lower body meet a believable ground line.
Every scene has visible right-to-left background movement.
The active speaker uses the assigned Fish Audio voice.
Music has no vocals, clipping, or dead loop gap and stays below the dialogue.
A nontechnical viewer can repeat the lesson after watching.
The analogy uses objects and behavior from the selected story world.
